track.why: Jul 27 2024, summited, 111 m from our Dingford Creek pin at both ends (42.7 mi, 5,763 ft); follows the Middle Fork valley to Dutch Miller Gap then reaches the summit from the west, matching the SW Face approach text; no logged route name but the histogram has a 'Southwest Face' July entry and the line is not the SE slab. Moderate confidence.

facts.text: In early August two parties rode mountain bikes up the gated Dingford road for the first 7 miles or so, then hiked on to Dutch Miller Gap; the road is rough enough that a mountain bike beats a gravel bike.
Getting into the pitch-2 chimney is the crux; leave your pack off to squeeze in, and shorter climbers found the opening moves hardest.
In early August both parties strayed left on the lower face onto class 4 and low 5th ground; going higher before traversing finds the easier line.
In early August a north-facing snow patch near the summit-block notch was still giving meltwater when the face has no other water.
The lowest 500 ft of the face is the slowest to downclimb; two August parties were caught by dark, one spending the night in trees about 300 ft above the base, so start down early.

notes: Infinite Beauty and Timeless Treasure (SE Mega Slab, Salmon La Sac approach) could not be tied to any track; the only harvested track uses the Dingford approach. SW Face summit pin (47.54,-121.2256) is 18 m from the track high point and 23 m from Peakbagger; no move. Dingford pin is 111 m from the track start; no move.
